speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you recently had acute sinusitis treated with antibiotics, but now you have fever, flank pain, and fatigue. Have you noticed any urinary symptoms like burning during urination, urgency, or changes in urine color?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis - Leukocyturia: Present, Bacterial_Culture: Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel’s_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm; Complete Blood Count - NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you notice any blood in your urine or visible changes in its color? REQUEST TEST: Urine Culture REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urine Culture - NORMAL READINGS; Blood Culture - NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: Are you experiencing any chills, night sweats, or severe shaking rigors along with your fever? REQUEST TEST: ESR (Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate) REQUEST TEST: ANA (Antinuclear Antibody)

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: ESR - NORMAL READINGS; ANA - NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any new skin rashes, joint pain, or swelling in your hands and feet since the sinusitis started? REQUEST TEST: Complement Levels (C3, C4) REQUEST IMAGES: Skin exam

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complement Levels - C3: NORMAL READINGS, C4: NORMAL READINGS; Skin exam - No current rash or lesions

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any severe muscle pain, dark urine, or swelling in your legs and face recently? REQUEST TEST: Creatine Kinase (CK), Liver Function Tests (AST/ALT, Bilirubin), and Serum Protein Electrophoresis

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Creatine Kinase (CK): NORMAL READINGS; Liver Function Tests (AST/ALT, Bilirubin): NORMAL READINGS; Serum Protein Electrophoresis: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
Have you noticed any swelling in your face or eyelids, or difficulty seeing clearly at night? REQUEST TEST: Antistreptolysin O (ASO) Titer REQUEST TEST: Anti-DNase B Titer

DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis
